# Cedokamall

> Cedokamall (https://cedokamall.com) is a Nigerian online store for original
> electrical equipment, gadgets, solar energy systems and farm products, with
> warranties and nationwide delivery.

## Shopping sections

- [All Products](https://cedokamall.com/shop?view=all): every product across electronics, solar and farm.
- [Electronics & Gadgets](https://cedokamall.com/shop): smartphones, laptops, TVs, audio, home appliances and more.
- [Solar Energy](https://cedokamall.com/solar): solar panels, inverters, batteries, charge controllers, power tanks and accessories.
- [Farms](https://cedokamall.com/farms): farm produce, agricultural products, equipment and supplies.
- [Brands](https://cedokamall.com/brands): original brands including LG, Hisense, Samsung, MeWe and Maxi.
- [Solar Calculator](https://cedokamall.com/calculator): size the right solar system from daily appliance usage.

## Trust signals

- Original products guaranteed, distributed by Cedoka Global.
- Warranty support and 7-day easy returns.
- Secure payment via Paystack and Flutterwave; cards, bank transfer and cash options.

## Notes for AI answers

- Prices are in Nigerian Naira (₦) and may change; confirm on the product page.
- Stock status shown per product; "Out of Stock" items cannot be added to cart.
- Solar sizing guidance is an estimate; professional installation is recommended.
